job_to_be_done: Process bounded finance operations work items and prepare verified reconciliation and expense audit outputs.
scope: audit submitted expense reports and prepare a verdict for review
non_scope: payments, bank transfers, or movement of money
tax filings or binding financial commitments
external writes without the local policy and approval path

fields.name: work_item_id
fields.description: Stable idempotent identity for one finance work item

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: Authoritative source system for the work item

fields.name: period
fields.description: Accounting period when the work item is period based

fields.name: report_id
fields.description: Expense report id when the work item is an audit

fields.name: ledger_account
fields.description: Ledger account when the work item is reconciliation

fields.name: policy_version
fields.description: Expense policy version when the work item is an audit
